name: PYMEHackers Control Center
description: PYMEHackers Control Center indicator for the GNOME Shell top bar. It opens the menu with the Systems and Cybersecurity sections and the installed modules, discovered dynamically from the /usr/share/pymehackers/modules registry, plus a catalog to install modules from the PHCC-modules repository. It is the native equivalent of the MATE AppIndicator, without depending on gnome-shell-extension-appindicator.
